access_methods_reviewed.finding: BOM states users must check terms for content; permissions may be by data licence agreement or CC BY where stated.
Public latest observations state observations can be retained/removed by age and are not quality controlled.
Official pages expose JSON/AXF formats, but repeated commercial runtime collection/republication requires product/service terms confirmation.
Official station map identifies observation station locations for discovery evidence only.

attribution_requirements: Bureau of Meteorology/Commonwealth attribution required where licensed; exact product terms must be confirmed.
decision: Do not enable scheduled BOM production collection until BOM product/service terms are confirmed for EDGEiQ commercial/runtime use.
